title: pi-durable is ticfac's only worker harness, local and cloud
description: Operator, 2026-10-04: adopt pi-durable (Earendil, github.com/earendil-works/pi packages/durable) as the single worker harness — all-in, no flag, no parallel pi-CLI path; we are still in development. Design and evidence: docs/spikes/n0b-round2-pi-durable.md (PR #210): cloud = a WorkerAgent DO per attempt holding the conversation in DO SQLite, tools in that attempt's FactorySandbox container (umq); local = a Node harness process per worker on local SQLite, tools in the worktree; wip commit after every tool round so a lost container is restored; any number of clients watch/steer each conversation. Prototype proved cross-process resume (1.3s, no double execution), container loss restored from wip in 25.8s, live watch + steer (33ms). Storage: DO SQLite (p50 29ms) for checkpoints, R2 JSONL as archive, D1 optional queryable mirror. Workers AI only in the cloud, via the factory gateway with the run token. Risks: pi-durable's API churns (0.0.1 to 1.0.2 in 15 days) — pin exact versions + conformance/replay tests in CI; it is not the pi CLI — prompts/quality re-checked by real runs. Supersedes jd3 (Pi 1.0 CLI upgrade). Open decision to settle before the local-host tick: the local frontier rung today is the claude CLI on the Max subscription, which pi-durable cannot host.

2026-10-04 14:04 - Pi 1.0 findings from the stopped jd3 work (PR #211, closed; 0.85.1 → 1.0.2), for 92k/oq4/pom: (1) 1.0.1 dropped npm-shrinkwrap — pin pi-durable/pi-ai/pi-agent-core with our own pnpm lockfile (exempt @earendil-works/* from the release-age gate). (2) SDK/extension breaking changes hit pi-durable directly: custom providers get TranscriptContext and must read getCurrentSystemPrompt()/getCurrentTools(); ToolCall.arguments and ToolResultMessage.details must be JSON-compatible; user_bash fails closed; shouldStopAfterTurn removed → finishTurn {action:'end'}; SessionManager is the single source of model context (agent.state.messages assignment no longer applies → appendContextEdit/refreshContext); turn_end carries boundary fields; new agent_before_settle event. (3) Mid-conversation system messages + turn_end/agent_before_settle hooks are the native way to do linter pushback (#183) and stuck nudges without a second process. (4) Unknown model id now exits 1 visibly. (5) pi's catalog lists GLM 5.3 (and Flash) with a 1.0M output limit — keep the maxTokens 65536 override. (6) Effort may not take effect for GLM: --model …:medium and --thinking medium both recorded thinkingLevel high on 0.85.1 and 1.0.2 — verify per model in oq4.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] Every worker (implement and role jobs), local and cloud, runs on pi-durable; the pi-CLI worker path is deleted. [A2] A harness process killed mid-tool resumes in a new process without re-running the tool; a container destroyed mid-turn is restored from the last wip commit and the turn completes — proven on staging and in a real run. [A3] ticfac watch shows a worker's thinking and tool calls live and the operator can steer; the stuck nudge is a steer. [A4] A real hn6-style cloud epic run and a local epic run complete on pi-durable. [A5] make gate, cloudflare tests and the harness package's conformance + replay tests pass in CI.
